checks.details: Every UI-relevant AC for F-007 (AC-020..027), F-008 (AC-028..033), F-009 (AC-034..040) has at least one component or validation rule addressing it. AC-027 (Inward atomicity), AC-033 (Sales Δ=-nos at ledger), and AC-039 (Adjustment ledger apply) are backend invariants — the UI's responsibility is correctly limited to forming a valid payload + reporting success/failure as a unit via the mutation, which the spec captures.

ac_map.AC-025: InwardForm submit handler strips lines where nos == null || nos === 0 before mutation (RULE-017 client-side mirror)
ac_map.AC-026: InwardForm zod lines.refine(arr => arr.some(l => l.nos != null && l.nos > 0), 'AC-026')

ac_map.AC-032: SalesForm zod nos refinements (mirror of AC-024)
ac_map.AC-033: Backend invariant (stock.apply_sale Δ=-nos); UI just submits payload
ac_map.AC-034: AdjustmentCreate type has design_id ONLY on header; AdjustmentLineCreate excludes design_id — structurally enforced (mirrors T-046)

ac_map.AC-038: AdjustmentLineRow live-computed difference via react-hook-form watch() with aria-live='polite' — TC-101
ac_map.AC-039: Backend invariant (stock.apply_adjustment Δ=difference); UI just submits payload
ac_map.AC-040: AdjustmentForm Err012Banner shown when getGradesWithCb returns []; line entry hidden + submit disabled — TC-102

checks.details: All UI components live within M-006 (Frontend) per HLD. The 3 form pages (app/inward/new, app/sales/new, app/adjustments/new), shared components (components/ui, components/transactions), api.ts, mocks.ts, schemas.ts, types/transactions.ts, hooks/transactions all reside in frontend/src/. No component reaches into M-002 (backend application layer) or M-003 (backend domain) directly — UI consumes M-002 HTTP endpoints which compose M-003 server-side. The Transactions nav-sidebar addition modifies one existing S1 file in M-006 — within boundary. DS-006 (frontend/backend as separate Docker images, HTTP-only coupling) honored.

8 endpoints referenced; all map to actual LLD interfaces. POST /api/v1/inward (T-052+T-047) accepts InwardCreate {purchase_date, supplier_id, entered_by_id, lines[]} — matches T-046 schema. POST /api/v1/sales (T-053+T-048) accepts SalesCreate {sales_date, dealer_id, loading_staff_id, verified_by_id, lines[]} — matches. POST /api/v1/adjustments (T-054+T-049) accepts AdjustmentCreate {stock_date, entry_date, design_id, entered_by_id, lines[]} — matches (note: AdjustmentLineCreate has grade_id + physical_cb only; software_cb intentionally omitted per AC-036, server-snapshotted). GET /api/v1/designs/{id}/grades-with-cb?stock_date= (T-055+T-050) returns list[DesignGradeReadWithCb {grade_id, grade_code, software_cb}] — matches. S1 reused endpoints (suppliers/dealers/staff/designs/designs.grades) — all match S1 contracts. Place field correctly absent from all *Create payloads (DS-013) and server-derived; present on *Read responses for display.

endpoint_map.POST /api/v1/inward: T-052 router + T-047 service + T-046 InwardCreate/Read
endpoint_map.GET /api/v1/sales: T-053 + T-048 list_sales(date_from, date_to, dealer_ids?, design_ids?)

warnings.description: ui_spec uses the placeholder name 'GradeReadMin' for the S1 GET /designs/{id}/grades response item; the actual S1 schema is 'DesignGradeReadMin' (verified in S1 designs.py imports). Functionally equivalent shape ({grade_id, grade_code}), but the TS type alias and import should use the canonical name to align with the backend Pydantic class and avoid two-name drift.
warnings.fix_at_scaffold: When generating types/transactions.ts (or hooks/transactions), import or re-export DesignGradeReadMin from the S1 master schemas mirror, NOT define a parallel 'GradeReadMin' type. Update mocks.ts to use the same name.

warnings.description: The spec correctly notes that useGradesWithCb is gated on (design_id && stock_date). However, if the user changes stock_date AFTER selecting a design (and the query re-runs returning [] because the date moved to a window with no closing balances), the form should re-show Err012Banner. Make sure the AdjustmentLineRow field-array is reactive to query refetch, not just a one-shot populate on first response.
warnings.fix_at_scaffold: Use useEffect on data change to reset(form.values.lines, newLines) whenever getGradesWithCb data updates, not just on initial load. The Err012Banner visibility binds to data.length === 0, which is naturally reactive — no extra work needed there.
